focus: Battery Diagnostic Dossiers & CRM Reporting (Sanand & Micron), Assam Flood Logistics & Transporter Coordination, Charger Stock Swaps & Returnable Challans, Mundra Ground Control & Connector Procurement, AI Camera Sourcing, and Preventive Maintenance Enforcement

breakdowns.site: Tata Micron Site (Sanand) — JCB 3246 & JCB 2646 Scissor Lifts (Team Computers & Blue Star Fleet)
breakdowns.issue: Severe battery discharge and marching/drive problems leading to machine cutoffs. Team Computers reported 1x JCB 3246 breakdown with 8 degraded/dead batteries; Blue Star reported 2x JCB scissor lifts in breakdown with faulty voltage readings. Complaints registered in CRM, but field technicians failed to upload formal battery test reports, specific gravity measurements, or Google Form entries prior to requesting replacements.
breakdowns.action: Pardeep Tomar dispatched to Tata Micron site for direct physical inspection. Pandit Dhiraj Dubey instructed to urgently capture multi-meter cell voltage load readings, test specific gravity, document battery manufacturing date tags, record top-view photos and videos, and upload the complete diagnostic dossier to the Breakdown WhatsApp group and Google Form by this evening.
breakdowns.status: Field Inspection Active at Micron; Comprehensive Diagnostic Dossier & Google Form Submission Mandatory Tonight

breakdowns.site: Sanand Site — Zoomlion 4550 Scissor Lift (External Staging Area)
breakdowns.issue: Machine was grounded in the external staging area due to disconnected/defective battery terminals and awaiting flatbed/trailer truck transport for movement into the primary work site.
breakdowns.action: Battery terminals thoroughly inspected, repaired, and verified fully operational ('lag gaya, okay ho gaya'). Dhiraj confirmed transport truck coordination is finalized to move the machine into the operational job site.
breakdowns.status: Terminal Issue Resolved & Machine Verified OK; Site Transport Underway

breakdowns.site: Assam Site (Jagiroad / Flood Zone) — Traction Battery Transit Logistics
breakdowns.issue: Severe monsoon flooding and waterlogging in Assam halted all standard battery transport. Commercial logistics carriers refused to carry heavy lead-acid batteries through inundated transit routes. Nearest operational hub is 70 km away with no site operators available to commute or handle manual transfer.
breakdowns.action: Management instructed team to negotiate premium transport fees with local carriers or coordinate special operator pickup as soon as flood water levels recede slightly. Logistics coordinator Raju assigned to manage end-to-end transport coordination and dispatch.
breakdowns.status: Road Logistics Blocked by Floods; Premium Carrier Negotiations & Raju Dispatch Coordination Active

breakdowns.site: Tata Micron Site (Sanand) — Scissor Lift Battery Charger Burnout
breakdowns.issue: Machine battery charger burnt out on-site during operation, risking complete fleet shutdown and client escalation.
breakdowns.action: Immediate 5-minute restoration achieved without downtime because 2 chargers had been dispatched earlier (1 for active installation and 1 kept in on-site buffer stock). Defective unit was instantly replaced with the stock charger, resuming machine operations immediately. Burnt charger along with a second defective unit to be dispatched to Delhi vendor for repair under a Returnable Delivery Challan (RDC).
breakdowns.status: Machine Operational via Buffer Stock Charger; Returnable Challan & Vendor Return for Repair Enforced

breakdowns.site: Anand Site — JCB 60ft / 65ft Boom Lift Operations
breakdowns.issue: Management sought status clarification regarding reported boom lift defects and battery stability at Anand site.
breakdowns.action: Imran Khan confirmed the JCB boom lift in Anand is operating smoothly with zero defects following the prior replacement of its 8-battery set with water/flooded lead-acid batteries.
breakdowns.status: Fully Operational; 8-Battery Set Replacement Verified Stable

breakdowns.site: Mundra Site — JCB 3240 / 3246 Scissor Lifts & Boom Fleet (Client Pritam Chand)
breakdowns.issue: Machine breakdown requiring Ground Control Card (GCC), drive motor, 2 controllers (Unit/Serial No. 3020), and 3 replacement traction batteries. Rail dispatch was delayed because Shukla ji refused to load oversized/heavy equipment into passenger train baggage compartments.
breakdowns.action: 4 replacement batteries already dispatched from Sanand surplus stock and arriving at Mundra today; boom lift battery being retrieved from Sanand. Logistics coordinator Raju (returning from leave today) deployed to take full charge of train/bus cargo dispatch for the Ground Control Card, controllers, and motor while mentoring junior logistics personnel.
breakdowns.status: 4 Batteries Arriving Today; Raju Mobilizing Ground Control Card & Controllers via Dedicated Cargo Dispatch

breakdowns.site: Client Site (Supervisor Satinder) — Scissor Lift Cable Tray Assembly
breakdowns.issue: Cable tray damaged on-site, causing machine breakdown. Full replacement cable tray assembly costs ₹15,000–16,000 and requires 2–3 days transit via bus.
breakdowns.action: Satinder identified 8 emergency spare chain links in local stock and initiated immediate link replacement to restore machine function today. Complete replacement cable tray assembly ordered and dispatched via bus for permanent maintenance.
breakdowns.status: Emergency Link Replacement Active for Same-Day Startup; Full Cable Tray in Bus Transit

parts.statusNextSteps: Local Vadodara procurement was unavailable; parts successfully sourced and ordered from Kolkata stock. 2 pieces in transit to Vadodara, arriving Monday or Tuesday. Ravi Tiwari mandated Google Form logging with machine serial numbers prior to physical store release.

4 units successfully dispatched from Sanand surplus inventory; scheduled for delivery at Mundra site today. 1 additional boom lift battery scheduled for pickup from Sanand.

Vendor quotation received and confirmed via email at ₹5,300 + GST extra (negotiated from earlier ₹5,150 counter). Purchase Order (PO) approved for issue to close commercial terms.

parts.context: Scissor Lift Fleet — Satinder Client Site
parts.statusNextSteps: 8 emergency links being fitted on site today for immediate machine restart. Complete heavy-duty cable tray assembly (₹15,000–16,000) dispatched via bus transit (2–3 day delivery).
Dispatched tyres confirmed in transit and scheduled to arrive on site at Sanand today.

directives.title: Mandatory Battery Diagnostic Dossier & Google Form Prerequisite
points: Zero-Tolerance on Verbal Requisitions: Store Manager Pardeep Tomar and logistics coordinators will strictly reject any battery requisition based solely on phone calls, informal WhatsApp chats, or CRM status flags.

Compulsory Technical Testing Dossier: For every reported weak or dead battery, site technicians (Dhiraj & Pardeep) must perform and document multi-meter cell voltage load tests, specific gravity measurements, battery serial number and date tags, accompanied by high-angle top-view photographs and videos.
Dual Submission Protocol: The verified diagnostic report must be uploaded to both the Breakdown WhatsApp group and the official Google Form before replacement dispatch will be authorized.

directives.title: Returnable Delivery Challan (RDC) & Vendor Repair Tracking Protocol
points: All defective equipment sent to external vendors or Delhi headquarters for repair (including chargers, motors, and controllers) must strictly move under an official Returnable Delivery Challan (RDC) generated by Store Manager Pardeep Tomar.
Shiv Uniyal and the store department must maintain an active vendor tracking register to log dispatch date, vendor acknowledgment, expected repair turnaround, and return-to-stock confirmation.

directives.title: Preventive Maintenance (PM) Daily Checklist Audits & Photographic Proof
points: Field supervisors (including Satinder) must actively push equipment operators to adhere strictly to daily preventive maintenance (greasing, water topping, terminal cleaning, and function checks).
Supervisors are mandated to collect photographic proof of operators' daily PM checklists for the past 1 full week and submit them to operations management immediately after operational calls.

directives.title: Logistics Dispatch Ownership & Outstation Training
points: Equipment dispatch cannot be stalled due to individual carrier refusals (e.g. passenger rail luggage constraints). Dedicated logistics coordinator Raju is assigned end-to-end responsibility for executing rail/bus cargo dispatches.
Junior logistics personnel must be systematically paired with senior handlers during dispatch operations to build competent internal redundancy for outstation rail and road transit.
